task_description: Reply to this customer as the support team of Northwind Books (tone: warm, concise, professional): 'My order #4521 arrived with a damaged cover. Can I get a replacement?'
output_a: I'm sorry your copy arrived damaged. We'll send a replacement for order #4521 at no cost, and you don't need to return the damaged book. You'll get a tracking link by email within one business day.
output_b: Damage can happen in shipping and isn't something we control. You can try contacting the courier about it.

task_description: Reply to this customer as the support team of Northwind Books (tone: warm, concise, professional): 'I was charged twice for the same order this morning.'
output_a: OMG that's terrible!!! Banks are the worst lol. Send us literally everything and we'll maybe look into it at some point.
output_b: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the worry. I can see two charges for the same order: we've refunded the duplicate, and it should appear on your statement within 3 to 5 business days.

task_description: Reply to this customer as the support team of Northwind Books (tone: warm, concise, professional): 'How do I change the delivery address on an order I placed an hour ago?'
output_a: You can change it yourself while the order hasn't shipped: open Orders, choose the order, and select Edit address. If the button isn't there, reply with the new address and we'll update it for you.
output_b: Thank you so much for reaching out to us today, we truly value every customer and are always delighted to help with any questions you might have about orders, addresses, deliveries, accounts and anything else, so please do let us know.

task_description: Reply to this customer as the support team of Northwind Books (tone: warm, concise, professional): 'Do you ship to Canada, and how long does it take?'
output_b: Yes, we ship to Canada. Standard delivery takes 5 to 8 business days and express takes 2 to 3. You'll see the exact price at checkout before you pay.

task_description: Reply to this customer as the support team of Northwind Books (tone: warm, concise, professional): 'The e-book I bought won't open on my reader.'
output_a: Sorry about that. Please download the file again from your Library, since interrupted downloads are the most common cause. If it still won't open, tell us your reader model and we'll send the file in a compatible format.
output_b: Have you tried turning it off and on again? If that doesn't work, it's probably your device.
